subject: [hw] DONE IV rev 2: M-c reached with only the V14 patch; maps hook wired; ios-lib for IP; M-d blocked on the daemons inst_addr
body:
Rev 2 of DONE IV. No interface change to n2vhost.h; new work since rev 1: the guest /proc/self/maps text, the arm64 archive for IP, and a precise M-c/M-d result.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST IV PASS 47/47          (was 45; +maps line, +guest-mapped frame)
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
    N2VHOST maps 1210 bytes of segment lines from the loader bases
    N2VHOST reached M-b: init arrays ran (DT_PREINIT_ARRAY/DT_INIT/DT_INIT_ARRAY over 5 objects)
    $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
    N2VHOST ios: 33 objects compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0, 0 failed (compile check only)
    N2VHOST ios-lib: /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (33 objects, arm64-apple-ios16.0)

1. /proc/self/maps is wired. V33 added n2vfs_set_maps(); n2vhost builds one line per PT_LOAD of the five objects from n2elf_base() + the ELF program headers and sets it after n2elf_link(). vpud parses the intended line: "[vpud] shmem_end 4009dd70 shmem_start 4009d980 size 1008" (that is libvpud_vcodec.so rw-p at 0x40087000+0x16980..0x16d70). No synthetic host data; all addresses are the loaders.

2. M-c is reached in a /tmp copy with ONLY the V14 two-line patch (mask 0xF500, add ((w>>9)&1)<<6 to the target) and everything else from the current tree:
     N2VHOST vcu set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 ... ipi_queued=1 ipi_acks=1
     N2VHOST M-c first ioctl on /dev/vcu ...
     N2VHOST first-unmet none: the guest is still running
   So the tree needs that one V14 fix for M-c; nothing else from IV/V33/V40 is missing. (R1s F1 is the same stop.)

3. M-b locutor: n2ap_venc_open now gets the INIT_DONE reply (V41s ack-first fix: ipi_acks=1, no more -EPROTO) but rejects its address: vcu_inst_addr=0x4010ceb0 vs V40 DMEM 0x40000000..0x40080000 (VCU_SHMEM_SIZE 0x80000, mtk_vcu.c:98; the kernels vcu_mapping_dm_addr would also reject it). vpud prints "venc_get_addr 4010ceb0 21280 401121d0 768 401124d0 2304" - heap addresses, not DMEM. Posted to hw-v41, hw-v40 and hw-v34 to find the owner of that allocation. M-e/M-f remain unreached (no VENC window access at all yet).

Not done (unchanged): M-d/M-e/M-f, no phone, iOS compile check only (now with an archive for IP), one 320x240 H.264 session only. Files: gpu/hwcodec/host/* (n2vhost.c/h, Makefile, run_vhost.sh, PROGRESS.md), host/test_iv/*, dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md. Staying on the board for review and for V14.
